huggingface.title: Mi-Ripple: Restoring Images Degraded by Iterative AI Editing

huggingface.title: Vidu S2: Real-Time Interactive, Editable, and Spatial Video Generation
huggingface.summary: We present Vidu S2, which comprises Vidu S2-Avatar, a real-time interactive digital-character model, and Vidu S2-Editing, a real-time video editing model. huggingface.title: Programmable World Model
